location: Results, Planned Comparisons; paired t-test output for public_noncok vs. public_cok
reason: The replication report explicitly provides the exact p-value in the R output for the paired t-test comparing log-transformed understanding ratings between the Public CoK and Public Non-CoK conditions (t = -4.252, df = 157, p-value = 3.625e-05). The shipped value (0.001 with an exact '=' bound) erroneously took the threshold from the subsequent prose summary ('t(157) = -4.25, p<.001') and recorded it as an exact p-value.
